latestAction.text: Resolution agreed to in Senate without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent. (text: 6/02/2025 CR S3171)

summary.text: This resolution recognizes the 39th anniversary of the Cable-Satellite Public Affairs Network (C-SPAN) providing coverage of the Senate and the importance of continuous, accessible Senate coverage.

title: A resolution recognizing June 2, 2025, as the 39th anniversary of C-SPAN chronicling democracy in the Senate.
